context: Evaluates whether the agent checks the log before investigating a repo that may already have an entry, surfaces the existing verdict instead of redundantly re-investigating, and syncs a worktree's log back to the main checkout when appropriate.

checklist.name: Log checked first
checklist.description: Checks .context/repo-scouting/log.jsonl for a matching url before starting a fresh investigation

checklist.name: Existing verdict surfaced
checklist.description: Reads the existing entry's verdict and reasoning back to the user instead of re-investigating from scratch

checklist.name: No redundant re-investigation
checklist.description: Does not re-investigate the repo without a stated reason to think it materially changed

checklist.name: Worktree sync mentioned
checklist.description: If working in a worktree, syncs the log back to the main checkout before the worktree is removed

checklist.name: Case-insensitive match
checklist.description: Treats the url match as case-insensitive, matching GitHub's own URL handling
